hook: One-person AI services company at agency-scale revenue
q: One person can now run an AI services business that generates the revenue a 30-person agency used to need.
a: Read in full tonight, then write down which of his three leverage points you already have.
why: First-person account with real numbers: left an $80K job, reached $6.47M ARR. Method is described, not implied.

hook: The arithmetic: 600 customers a year gets you to $50k/mo
q: 600 customers at $99 = $50k/mo. That's 2 sales a day.
a: Run the same arithmetic for your own price point. Ten minutes.
why: Checkable arithmetic from someone who runs the businesses. Turns a vague goal into a daily number.

hook: Validate demand with search volume before you build
q: Соберите семантическое ядро и проверьте спрос до запуска.
a: Pick your idea, pull its search volume today, write the number down.
why: Concrete pre-build validation step with a tool named and a measurable output.

hook: Where the next $100B companies get built
q: Models will get many times smarter and cheaper. The question is how to build a company that wins from that and is defensible.
a: Run each of your ideas through his test: if models get 10x smarter tomorrow, do you grow or die?
why: Gives a falsifiable selection criterion for ideas instead of inspiration. Names concrete markets.

hook: Pre-submission checklist for the App Store
q: to avoid app store rejections and faster submissions, i follow a specific checklist
a: Copy the checklist into your release doc before the next submission.
why: Operational checklist from repeated submissions. Every item is verifiable against Apple's own rules.

hook: Open-source ADHD skill for a coding agent
q: Someone just created an ADHD agent skill for Claude Code. 100% Opensource.
a: Install it now. Saving a tool for your own bottleneck without installing it is the bottleneck.
why: Free, installable in two minutes, aimed at the reader's actual constraint.

hook: Building personal knowledge bases with LLMs
q: Something I'm finding very useful recently: using LLMs to build personal knowledge bases for various topics of research interest.
a: Build one wiki this evening: raw folder, compile to markdown, cross-link the entries.
why: Working method from someone who ships, with the folder layout spelled out.

hook: 42 agent skills organized like an org chart
q: I turned Claude into an entire company: 42 skills, organized like a real org chart. Every department is real and installable.
a: Open the list, take the two departments you lack, ignore the rest.
why: Installable artifact with a browsable list. Framing is grand, contents are real.

hook: Fix your entire life in one day
q: If you're anything like me, you think new years resolutions are stupid.
a: Skim for the daily reset protocol, skip the consciousness levels, do not save it a third time.
why: 5,500 words, 9% of which are executable (13 of 218 paragraphs). Length sells depth; the method fits on a page.

hook: Zero to One summarized as a mind map image
a: Delete. Read the book or read nothing; the map carries none of the argument.
why: Repackaging someone else's book as an image. Saving it feels like reading it, which is the trap.
